chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Mufazzal ibn Umar, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'The one who reports upon a believer with a report intending to defame him and demolish his dignity/personality, so that he falls from the eyes of the people, Allah will remove him from His guardianship to the guardianship of Satan, and Satan will not accept him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of backbiting a believer with the intent to defame them?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) delineates the spiritual mechanism of *al-ghibah* (backbiting) as a transfer of divine guardianship (*wilayah*) to satanic guardianship, contingent upon the intent to defame. This transition highlights a critical Shia theological concept where the believer's status is not merely lost but actively exchanged, yet the hadith adds a profound nuance: Satan ultimately rejects the defamer, indicating that while they fall from divine favor, they do not achieve full integration into the realm of evil due to the specific nature of their action. This serves as a stern warning against social ostracization in early Shia communities, emphasizing that intent (*niyyah*) dictates the spiritual destination of the individual.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Mufazzal Bin Umar who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘The one who reports upon a Momin with a report intending to defame him with it and demolish his personality to drop him from the eyes of the people, Allahazwj would Exit him from Hisazwj Wilayah to the wilayah of the Satanla, but the Satanla will not accept him’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Mufaddal ibn ‘Umar who has said the following: “Once

abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) said to me, ‘Whoever makes a narration against a believer intending thereby to defame him and destroy his honor to discredit him in the eyes of people, Allah moves him out of His guardianship to that of Satan, and Satan will not accept him.’”
